needleCast.notes: Bone Needle: an ivory sliver thrown. Fires on every attack, so short and quiet.

needleHit.notes: Small dry tick. Crit/shatter calls pass intensity 1.4 (louder), not a new clip.

spear.notes: Marrow Spear, Reap, Hollow Cut / Ivory Cleave wind-ups. Earth = bone. See hollowCut/ivoryCleave for the blade rites.

exhume.notes: Grave earth heaving plus a shadow tail (spirit-teal rite).

thrallRise.notes: A summoned body "poofs" up. Also the Rally the Dead call today (see rallyDead).

miasma.notes: Miasma Circle cast (rot green): poison exhaust hisses. Zone loop is miasmaLoop.

litany.notes: Black Litany (violet void): long arcane cast with a dark-lightning turn. One at a time; intensity scales with the sacrifice.

thrallMelee.notes: Quiet by design; thinned further by the mixer.

wail.notes: Wailing Skull (jade spirit): "hollow, creepy" liquid bolts. Each hop plays at intensity 0.6.

bloodStep.notes: Grave Step, Veil Step today, Shield Bash, Grave Slam: mist dissolving.

frost.notes: Grave Frost cone. SPELL_FX.frost is cold blue, so ice.

mantle.notes: Bone Mantle: corpses drawn into a bone barrier (aged grey bone, so earth).

siphon.notes: Soul Siphon cast (jade): draining essence. Tether loop is siphonLoop.

prison.notes: Bone Prison: spikes erupt in a ring.

hands.notes: Grave Hands: the buried dead clawing up (earth + debris). Field loop is handsLoop.

storm.notes: Bone Storm: a storm of fragments. Lightning/Thunderstorm clips rejected (the storm is bone and ash, not weather).

soulRelease.notes: Soul Harvest / wraith nova: jade spirit released.

sigWall.notes: Ossuary Wall rising: heavy stone drag.

sigRend.notes: Command: Rend, the legion leaps and cleaves (jade/bone).

sigDirge.notes: Dirge: cold-blue funeral song as a long ice shimmer. No bell in the pack. Heals/mend loop is dirgeLoop.

sigBloom.notes: Plague Bloom: a rot flower unfurls (chartreuse).

raise.notes: Enemy raising the dead (Prelate, Lich Acolyte): a readable dark conjure.

burst.notes: Wet corpse burst (goo/gore squirt): contagion and seed bursts. Corpse Explosion itself gets corpseExplode.

lantern.notes: Lantern cone: warm holy light (warden gold).

chain.notes: Hook/chain: trap clanks stand in for chain links.

ward.notes: Watchman's Ward / Last Light / Lay to Rest.

choir.notes: Monk toll/knell/choir (resonant sound-gold). No bell clips; holy and meditation tones.

crow.notes: Witch crows. Only one clip is named Crow; verify by ear, else keep existing amb_crow.

enemyDeath.notes: Generic body drop / bone collapse. Family voices are the new enemyDeath* ids.

eliteDeath.notes: Heavy blow plus a gritty growl.

hurt.notes: Player takes damage. Non-spatial, always audible; ducks the rest briefly. The pack has no human grunts, so it is an impact only.

toll.notes: Bell-Tolled elite tell. NO bell in the pack: a metallic ring only. Keep the existing Kenney bell and layer this sting on top.

tollSmall.notes: Small bell toll (affixes, boss rings, corpse-explosion ring). PARTIAL as for toll: keep the existing bell, layer the pack ring.

emberCrackle.notes: Cinder Pyre ambient accent, trimmed so a forge burn never becomes a long hiss.

bossToll.notes: Prelate toll tell (danger). No bell: dark conjure body plus metallic sting. Keep the existing octave-down Kenney bell underneath until a bell exists.

bossSlam.notes: Boss slam / maul / cleave impact. Never culled by distance (priority 5).

bossAwaken.notes: Boss wakes: dark lightning plus a long low growl.

bossDefeat.notes: Boss falls: a release, not a fanfare.

wave.notes: Wave spawn / breach: a low distant rumble. Verify it is not too musical.

shard.notes: Soul shards: dark-magic collect. The Bulwark / Grave Brand accents reuse it today (see bulwarkRaise, graveBrand).

error.notes: Refusal (cannot / not enough): a latch that will not give.

panelOpen.notes: Dry variants: UI must not carry a reverb tail. Specific panels use panelOpenInventory / panelOpenBook / panelOpenForge.

vaultOpen.notes: The pack names open and close as one clip ("Open_or_Close"). Verify by ear that open and close differ; if not, use one set for both.

pick.notes: Geode / stone node and the generic mining id. Ore seams use pickOre.

splash.notes: Fishing cast / pool node. Alchemy shares this id today (SKILLS.alchemy.sfx): route alchemy to brewTick.

shovel.notes: Gravedigging (grave node). Gritty drags read as a spade in soil; verify by ear. Gardening and salvaging share this id today: use gardenTend / grind.

craft.notes: Generic work-bench tap. Forge by gear type uses craftWeapon / craftArmor / craftMagic.

step.notes: Fallback = stone. Wire to stepStone / stepDirt / stepGrass / stepWater by the area table; keep this id as the default.

distantBell.notes: NO FIT: the pack has no bell. Keep the existing amb_bell clips.

graveCreak.notes: Wood-lever creaks stand in for crypt creaks; low and rare. Verify; else keep the synth.

waterDrip.notes: No true drip clip: single liquid pops/plops (UI dry versions). Verify; else keep amb_drip.

crowCaw.notes: "Creature Crow Distant" is monster-voice processed. Verify it reads as a bird; else keep amb_crow.

windGust.notes: NO FIT: no wind / air-movement clips in the pack. Keep the existing amb_gust.

crowdMoan.notes: Massed dead far off (Nave, Coliseum): low growl and insanity whisper at a whisper, low-passed by the ambience bus. Verify; else keep amb_moan.

dustFall.notes: Grit trickling down in the catacombs.

rotLance.site: src/gameplay/AbilitySystem.ts:1712 (cast, today needleCast), src/gameplay/AbilitySystem.ts:1744 (hit, today needleHit)
rotLance.notes: Rot Lance: chartreuse rot, a poison hiss on a dark cast.

boneFan.notes: Bone Fan: three slivers loosed together; crossbow volley.

hollowCut.notes: Hollow Knight sword arc. Cold steel, never bronze.

veilStep.notes: Veil Step (spirit jade) must not sound like Grave Step (crimson mist), same as the visual rule.

rallyDead.notes: Rally the Dead: a buff, not a raise.

carrionSeed.notes: Planting a rot seed: a sizzling reagent drop.

seedBurst.notes: Seed pops when an enemy nears.

corpseExplode.notes: Corpse Explosion (ember + crimson, bone shrapnel): fire boom with a gore tail. The big signature of the necromancer, so it can be loud, but cap at 3 voices for chain detonations.

graveSlamLand.notes: Landing; quieter than a boss slam (bossSlam v 0.9).

bulwarkBlock.site: src/gameplay/Player.ts (where bulwarkPerfectUntil is tested on a hit; silent today)
bulwarkBlock.notes: Perfect block: a ringing clank. Needs a tiny hook; the player-hurt path must NOT also play hurt for it.

oathUnbroken.notes: Oath crimson: dark conjure, not the violet litany.

graveBrand.site: src/gameplay/AbilitySystem.ts:2167 (sprung, today boneHit) and src/gameplay/AbilitySystem.ts:2172 (today shard)

thrallDeath.notes: Thrall collapses into bones. Quiet, within 24 m of the focus only (existing rule).

thrallBind.notes: Optional: partner-raised thralls (EntityViews). Same clip family as thrallRise, so can be skipped.

miasmaLoop.notes: Rot pool bed, 6 s: a soft hiss every 1.8 s while enemies stand in it.

boneStormLoop.notes: Fragments shredding; rapid dry debris ticks.

crowSwarmLoop.notes: Crow Swarm / Murder of Crows beds. Creature_High_* may read as monster squeals; verify, else keep the synth.

enemyAttackBeast.site: src/scenes/WorldScene.ts:2818 (WorldScene.ts:2818 case melee, look up the def like the Pyre spark code beside it)
enemyAttackBeast.notes: Hound, rat, bat, ghoul, cinderhound, mire leech. Silent today: enemy melee has no sound at all.

enemyAttackHumanoid.notes: Robber, penitent, deacon, risen, censer, acolyte, templar, plague doctor, flagellant, cinder husk, pyre priest, bog hag, drowned sexton.

enemyAttackBrute.notes: Bone golem, slag brute, carrion sac, gargoyle.

enemyAttackSpirit.notes: Choir wraith, weeping seraph, shroud moth, fen wisp.

enemyDeathBeast.site: src/scenes/WorldScene.ts:2799 case death, in addition to enemyDeath (look up ev.def)

eliteAggro.site: src/scenes/WorldScene.ts:3057 case spawn, elites only, within 40 m
eliteAggro.notes: An elite announces itself. Global 4 s cooldown so a pack does not roar in unison.

tellStrike.notes: The wind-up of an ordinary enemy blow or ground ring. Danger tells outrank everything but boss tells.

affixTell.site: src/scenes/WorldScene.ts:3018 case affix (hungering feed, vengeful burst)

surgeStart.notes: Grave Surge (enemy bell bronze): ominous thunder under the crypt.

bossTell.site: src/scenes/WorldScene.ts:3964 areaBossEvent, ms > 0 for any boss without an element entry
bossTell.notes: Generic boss wind-up. Play once at the START of the telegraph, never on release. Ducks thralls/enemies/ambience.

bossTellEarth.site: src/scenes/WorldScene.ts:3964 areaBossEvent: at the start of every telegraph (ms > 0), pick by ev.boss via BOSS_TELL (Gravedigger King, Bone Abbess)

bossTellWater.site: src/scenes/WorldScene.ts:3964 areaBossEvent, ms > 0, ev.boss congregation or mire (BOSS_TELL)
bossTellWater.notes: Hollow liquid; the Nave and Fen bosses.

bossSummon.site: src/scenes/WorldScene.ts:2097 interactable kind boss (the altar that wakes it)
bossSummon.notes: The ritual that wakes a boss, just before bossAwaken.

nicheBreak.notes: Shattering a skull niche. Pot smash reads as dry brittle shatter.

lowHealth.site: src/scenes/WorldScene.ts:3790 onHurt, and a 2.5 s tick while hp < 30%
lowHealth.notes: NO FIT: no heartbeat / pulse clip. Add a synth heartbeat in Audio.ts (low sine thump pair). Not routed through the pack.

lootDrop.site: src/graphics/LootView.ts:157 item() when rarity is common/uncommon
lootDrop.notes: A gear piece clatters to the ground.

lootDropRare.notes: Magic touch variant: a glint in the clatter.

lootDropLegendary.notes: A bright chime so it can be heard across the room. Rare, so loud is fine.

lootLegendary.site: src/audio/mixer.ts lootSfx() (returns lootEpic for legendary today)
lootLegendary.notes: Pickup of a legendary; lootSfx should return it before the epic check.

goldPileDrop.notes: Optional. Skip if coin spam is a concern; coin pickup already covers gold.

pickOre.site: src/scenes/WorldScene.ts:2556 and src/graphics/LaborerViews.ts:351, node.kind === 'seam' (SKILLS.mining.sfx is one id for seams and geodes)
pickOre.notes: Ore seams ring; geodes use pick (stone).

gardenTend.site: src/scenes/WorldScene.ts:2556 and LaborerViews.ts:351 for skill gardening (today shovel)

gardenReady.site: src/scenes/WorldScene.ts:314 gardenReady (when a bed turns ripe)

brewTick.site: src/scenes/WorldScene.ts:2556 and LaborerViews.ts:351 for skill alchemy (today splash)

craftWeapon.site: src/scenes/WorldScene.ts:1077 forge callback when the crafted item is a weapon or staff (today craft)

craftMagic.site: src/scenes/WorldScene.ts:1077, runes, rings, gems, enchanted pieces

forgeFire.site: src/scenes/WorldScene.ts:2060 interactable fire/kiln when the forge panel opens
forgeFire.notes: Optional: a flare as the hearth is opened.

chestOpen.site: src/scenes/DepthsController.ts:300 openChest (silent today; the drops that fan out play lootDrop*)

dialogueOpen.notes: The pack has no voices; a parchment rustle marks a conversation opening.

uiTab.site: tab switches: src/ui/CodexPanel.ts:118-122 [data-tab], and the same pattern in Grimoire / Forge / Professions / Ascension panels

uiSelect.site: selecting a rite / slot / list row in Grimoire, Legion, Reagent Shelf

uiConfirm.site: confirm buttons: bind rune, craft, assign loadout

uiNew.site: src/ui/Onboarding.ts:699 show() when a counsel card opens; HUD.ts:806 banner() for non-combat news
uiNew.notes: The NEW cue: soft sparkle. Cooldown 4 s so a tip queue is not a jingle.

panelOpenBook.site: src/scenes/WorldScene.ts:1447, codex, grimoire, ascension, atlas, contracts

stepStone.notes: Chapterhouse, Ossuary, Bell Sanctum, Depths, Warren floors, Alchemist's Wing.

stepGrass.notes: Sexton's Acre and the dry hummocks of the Fen.

stepWater.site: src/scenes/WorldScene.ts:4614 when worldView.isWet(p.x, p.z) (the wade test the ripples use)
stepWater.notes: Overrides the area surface wherever the player wades (Nave flood, Fen, Cloister pools).
